Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Conducted real-time web searches to verify exact birth dates for José Echegaray y Eizaguirre and P. J. O'Rourke.

  -- Thought: Compared the birth dates to determine who was born first.
  -- Result: Confirmed that José Echegaray y Eizaguirre was born first.

  -- Observation: Noted the birth dates from WebSurfer's results.
